name: probedesk
description: ProbeDesk — versioned measurement plans, deterministic simulator, run comparison

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run start --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:e2e: echo "The Playwright end-to-end suite is introduced by P7-01." >&2 && exit 1
scripts.openapi:emit: npm run db:generate --workspace apps/api && npm run openapi:emit --workspace apps/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:api:unit && npm run test:web && npm run build && npm run openapi:check
